title: Auramancy

tables.heading: Active Skills
rows: Inflicts Shaken on all enemies within a 6m radius, decreasing their Move Speed -27%, Skill Damage -8%, and Attack Speed -75. Grants the caster 1 stack of Inspired.

Inspired: Increases Attack Speed +53. Vicious Implosion (Auramancy): increases damage +52%. Antithesis (Vitalism): decreases cooldown 0.6 sec. Mend (Vitalism): decreases cooldown 2.1 Fervent Healing (Vitalism): decreases cooldown 1.2 sec. Stacks up to 3 times.
Fires a flash of light that deals 1380 Magic Damage to all enemies hit. Increases the Move Speed of all allies it passes.
Creates an energy shield for 8sec. Decreases Received Magic Damage —32.0%, but also decreases Received Healing by an equal amount. Does not trigger a global cooldown.
Gain Magic Shield while under Liberation.
Triggers a sudden, powerful implosion, pulling enemies within 10 meters towards you and dealing 982 Magic Damage.
Consumes all stacks of Inspired; inflicts additional +52% damage per stack. Increases Aggro +300% when used on Taunted targets.
Teleports caster 15 meters ahead. Can't teleport through walls or other solid Objects. Can't be used while Snared.
Increases max health +2086. Affects caster and nearby raid members for 30 minutes. Can't be used on targets whose health has already been increased.
Restores +4% Of max mana per second for 9sec through meditation. Prevents movement or other actions.

Cancels all Stun and Impale effects, and grants immunity to these effects for 5sec. Can only be used while under one of these effects. Can be used during global cooldown, and does not trigger global cooldown.
Grants immunity to Shackle and Silence for 20 sec.
Interrupts a target's casting and inflicts Sleep for 7sec. Steals one buff from the target. Targets will wake upon taking damage. Sleep duration reduced —50% in PvP.
Steals an additional buff from Slowed targets. Increases Slowed targets' Sleep duration +2 seconds.
Grants immunity to Magic Damage to allies within 5m for the duration.
Teleports caster 15m to the right or left. Can't pass through walls or other solid objects. Has a chance to escape enemy targetting during PvP. Can't be used while Snared.

tables.heading: Passive Skills
rows: Converts 7% of received damage to health.
Decreases all received damage -100 for 3 seconds after receiving critical damage. This ability has a 20 sec cooldown once triggered.
Grants a 1% chance to become immune to all damage for 2 seconds after receiving any damage. This ability has a 20 sec cooldown once triggered.
Increases the Accuracy of all attack types +8%.
Increases all Critical Rates and Critical Heal Rate +6%.
Teleportation has a 50% chance to eliminate its cooldown and allow consecutive teleports. Mirror Warp has a 50% chance to sustain the buff and allow consecutive use.

Auramancy Abyssal Wave (Rank 1) Abyssal Charges 4 ~ 6 Range: Caster only Magic Attack +180% Cast Time 1sec 14sec Cooldown Shoots a wave of force up to 20m in front of you.
